question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. **GARRULOUS**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Talkative**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Garrulous"** refers to someone who is excessively talkative, especially on trivial matters. (बहुत बातूनी)

 
 
• **Example:** The garrulous old man spent hours recounting stories of his youth to anyone who would listen.
 
 
 
• **"Talkative"** is the correct synonym, as it means someone who enjoys talking a lot, often about various topics. (बातूनी)
 
 
• **Example:** She is very talkative and loves sharing stories about her travels.
 
 
 
• Hence, "Talkative" is the most appropriate synonym for "Garrulous."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Talkative**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Noisy** (शोरगुल वाला): Producing or causing a lot of sound, especially of an unpleasant or disturbing nature.

 
 
• **Example:** The children were so noisy that it was hard to concentrate on my work.
 
 
 
• **Chatty** (बातूनी): Someone who is friendly and likes to talk, but not excessively.
 
 
• **Example:** She was in a chatty mood and happily shared stories about her day.
 
 
 
• **Sociable** (मिलनसार): Someone who enjoys being around and talking to other people.
 
 
• **Example:** He is very sociable and loves attending parties and meeting new people.

सही उत्तर है: **Talkative**।
